title: BNPL and pay-later apps — the easy-spend trap
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and pay-later apps let you spend first and pay later, often with zero interest if repaid on time. The risks are that it makes spending feel painless, late fees and interest can be steep (often equal to or higher than credit cards), missed payments can hurt your credit score, and many small dues across apps are easy to lose track of. Treat a pay-later limit as a loan, not income. Use it only for things you would buy anyway and can pay for in full when the bill arrives. Prefer lenders that are banks or RBI-registered, check the fees in the terms, and never share OTPs or screen access while onboarding to any lending app.
summary_hinglish: BNPL mein pehle kharcha, baad mein payment, aur time par chukane par kabhi byaj nahi. Par kharch karna aasaan ho jaata hai, late fee mehngi hoti hai aur credit score bhi gir sakta hai. Pay-later limit ko loan samjho, income nahi. Sirf unhi cheezon par use karo jo bill aane par poori chuka sako.
summary_hi: BNPL में पहले खर्च, बाद में भुगतान, और समय पर चुकाने पर कई बार ब्याज नहीं। पर खर्च करना आसान हो जाता है, लेट फीस महंगी होती है और क्रेडिट स्कोर गिर सकता है। पे-लेटर लिमिट को कर्ज़ समझें, आय नहीं। सिर्फ़ उन्हीं चीज़ों पर इस्तेमाल करें जिनका बिल पूरा चुका सकें।
